title: tanacetum aureum var. heimerlii
intro: Tanacetum aureum var. heimerlii, commonly known as Golden Tansy, is a flowering plant in the daisy family that is native to the mountainous regions of Europe. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects, which can help to reduce pain and prevent infection. The therapeutic actions of Golden Tansy include analgesic, antispasmodic, and carminative effects, making it useful for treating various conditions such as digestive issues and menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of Golden Tansy include sesquiterpene lactones, such as tanacetin and santitolin, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
